text: Welcome to your consultation. I see you are presenting with generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests; to understand the underlying cause, please describe any recent changes in your diet, travel history, or contact with others who may have had similar symptoms.

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). While your history of ulcerative colitis initially suggested Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC), the absence of biliary strictures on imaging, negative PSC-specific serology (ASCA, ANCA), and non-diagnostic liver biopsy are more consistent with PBC, particularly given the prominent cholestatic pattern and severe pruritus.
